children: Cousins provided an investor presentation at the BofA Securities Global Real Estate Conference highlighting premium Sun Belt office performance and a strong balance sheet.
Investor presentation filed as Exhibit 99.1 and posted on the company website for the Sept. 15, 2026 BofA conference.
Portfolio: 22.3M SF, 100% Sun Belt, 100% Class A, 2014 average build year, 92.8% leased.
Balance sheet: $1.1 billion liquidity (includes $89M unsettled forward equity) and 5.6x net debt/EBITDA, lowest in office sector.
Rents and leasing: Net effective rents up 33% vs pre-pandemic; asking rents 28% above pre-pandemic and 35% above Class A avg.
Growth pipeline and capital: 903K SF recently delivered, 5.1M SF land bank, and $1.4B+ of acquisitions sourced since 2024.
